text:
Hi everyone! It’s David and Peace here. We are an Israeli-Nigerian couple, and I must say that the process for us wasn’t smooth at all.
At first, we were very hopeful that the visa would be issued immediately after the first interview my husband attended because we had all the required documents. Unfortunately, we were wrong. We experienced unnecessary delays, and it wasn’t easy to get information, especially from Nigerians who had already gone through the process. As a result, we didn’t really know what to expect. Special thanks to Wendy Feringa,  Lior Beres Yana Mwakiti for all your contributions. 
Thankfully, when I finally arrived at the airport, everything went smoothly, and I didn’t experience any challenges.
At last, we are finally together after being apart for 1 year and 6 months! ❤️
A big thank you to every other person who came through with useful information and support. We truly appreciate it.
We also received our B/1 visa the day before yesterday! 🎉🇮🇱🇳🇬
Wishing everyone else going through the process a smooth and successful journey. ❤️
